entity.description:
Eventually, Slade gave Kane some of his own serum-altered blood to save her life. So she became unable to die from physical trauma or aging, but this also was driving her quite mad. She then turned herself into the H.I.V.E. Mistress, focusing on superheroes as the reason for her sons' death and creating a plan to kill all of them. When she regained her sanity, Kane asked Slade to kill her and reunite her with their children. As he was unable to do this, Starfire killed her instead.

Adeline Kane was created by Marv Wolfman and George Pérez, first appearing in (1983).
